identity.name: Gutter Cat Gang
identity.notes: Original 3,000 Gutter Cat collection identity. Newer migrations/releases must not silently replace this historical launch identity. Historical partner evidence proves Gutter characters entered a rigged 3D avatar pipeline. The Sandbox currently exposes an exhaustive 3,000-avatar Gutter Cats platform collection, and a 2025 report quoting a GCG team member says a newer completed Cat asset set was prepared for GLB/FBX delivery. The remaining catalog gap is direct supported-file delivery/enumeration, not whether usable 3D Gutter Cat avatars exist.

evidence.note: Current Etherscan token profile exposes the project's Discord alongside its official website and X account.
Current Etherscan token profile exposes the official X link.
Current project history states the Gutter Cat Gang was born in June 2021.
Independent historical source resolves the original collection launch to June 8, 2021.

ip_rights.summary: Current Gutter Cat Labs terms grant the holder a worldwide royalty-free personal license and an unlimited worldwide commercial license to create derivative works from the purchased Gutter NFT, subject to the current terms and separate treatment for third-party Licensed NFTs.

evidence.note: Sections 1.3 and 1.4 define personal and unlimited commercial use; section 1.2 separates third-party Licensed NFTs.

historical_avatar_development.summary: House of Kibaa/Looking Glass Labs, the project partner retained for the Gutter metaverse work, publicly stated in 2021-2022 that it was creating metaverse-ready Gutter assets and specifically designing, modeling and rigging Gutter Cat Gang characters for avatar-system integration. Later corporate material described Gutter Cat Gang among HoK third-party client avatars that its metaverse was designed to integrate. This proves real rigged-avatar development existed, but does not by itself prove a surviving downloadable file lane or supported file format.

evidence.note: Looking Glass Labs states HoK was creating metaverse-ready 3D Gutter assets and quotes GCG leadership describing the 3D project.
Looking Glass Labs explicitly says its technology was being used to design, model and rig Gutter Cat Gang characters for integration into a 3D metaverse.
Looking Glass Labs later lists Gutter Cat Gang among third-party client avatars intended for integration into HoK's Pocket Dimension.

platform_avatar_inventory.note: The Sandbox's current avatar shop exposes a Gutter Cats collection created by GutterLabsLLC with TOTAL AVATARS 3000 and 3000 assets. This is strong exhaustive proof that the original Cats have a complete usable platform-avatar representation. It does not satisfy the catalog file lane because no VRM/GLB/FBX download format or direct file URLs are exposed by this source.

evidence.note: The Sandbox page identifies the collection as created by GutterLabsLLC, reports TOTAL AVATARS 3000 and lists 3000 assets.

avatar_format_leads.note: A July 2025 Bored Ape Gazette report quotes Gutter Cat Gang team member Ceres saying the DashBo-designed 3D Cats were finished and a portal was being built to deliver each Cat as GLB, MML and FBX plus renders. This moves the question beyond historical WIP: production completion and intended supported formats are reported. However, no current first-party portal or direct file inventory was recovered, so the catalog still cannot claim delivery or enumerate the files.

evidence.note: Report quotes GCG team member Ceres saying the 3D modeled Cats were finished and naming GLB, MML and FBX for a download portal then under construction.
Current public site navigation exposes shop/collection/about surfaces but no discoverable 3D asset download portal.

avatar_inventory.note: Do not promote Gutter Cat Gang to a supported file inventory yet. We now have exhaustive proof of a 3,000-avatar platform representation and a later team-attributed report that GLB/FBX models were finished, but the acceptance contract requires an actual supported-file lane: direct URLs or a recoverable holder/public download surface plus exhaustive coverage. The current source set does not establish that delivery step.

evidence.note: Exhaustive 3,000-avatar Gutter Cats representation exists on The Sandbox, but this source does not expose supported catalog model files.
Finished GLB/FBX production and a planned download portal are reported, but current delivery is not independently confirmed.
Current owners expressly disclaim promises, warranties and obligations made by previous owners or teams, so historical delivery promises cannot close the current file lane.

project_status.note: The current project site and post-2024 Gutter Cat Labs terms remain active. Current management explicitly describes itself as the third owner of the Gutter Cat Gang IP, so historical promises must be evaluated against the current terms rather than assumed to carry forward.
